scope: Root independently rehashed54evidence files and8runtime/source/shader artifacts, read raw qualifiers and measurement controls, recomputed FPS/counter differences and primary-camera/reversal/fixed-B/inverse-label behavior from endpoint records. Inspected actual loaded native4K screenshot with world/units/minimap/HUD.
decision: Accept measured shipping native4K dynamic App baseline and strong observation gates. All3 fail240FPS goal. No application/platform/all-feature completion inferred.

limits.host: Unrelated Python/QEMU/long-lived Civ3 remain. No unrelated process was controlled. Host load/pressure and AMD telemetry are preserved. This is not a quiet-host hardware-limit result.
limits.quantiles: Per-report windows are retained; first partial windows excluded from comparisons. Wine and bridge duplicate logs are not pooled. Ranges are minima/maxima of individual-window quantiles, not a global quantile or an average of quantiles.
limits.timing_coverage: All drop deltas are zero and endpoint submitted/collected differences fit immutable ring32. Rep1 collected one sample more than submitted during the endpoint interval. These counters are not a matched per-frame submitted cohort and are not called exact full coverage.
limits.motion: All11 complete adjacent report intervals in each repetition move the same primary world camera, with5 positive and6 negative legs,10reversals and fixed inverse-label anchor. First/last partial intervals remain unobserved. B is fixed in every retained observation.
limits.CPU: Frame encode(host) is host command-preparation wall time, not total CPU utilization or a guarantee of unblocked CPU compute. Worker draw(all) includes acquire/submit/present walls.
limits.GPU_waiting_for_CPU: GPU inter-frame gap is retained separately and is not attributed solely to CPU starvation.
limits.platform_scope: Linux shipping runtime only. No macOS loaded-audio, deployment, or all-feature acceptance follows.

tiny_view_performance_lead: v2-v5 tiny world views each~1.25ms. Source-path investigation only; no optimization or matched causal attribution yet.
